source: O'Donoghue and Candes, Adaptive Restart for Accelerated Gradient Schemes, arXiv:1204.3982v1, Figures 1 and 3
stated_by_source: Fig. 1: n=200, q*=mu/L=4.1e-5, t=1/L, q values in the legend, displayed through 5000 iterations. Fig. 3: n=500, displayed through 2000 iterations, upper bound 700 and intervals 400/700 discussed, no restart, optimal q, both adaptive rules.
not_stated_by_source: Original matrices, spectrum generation, starts and random seed are unavailable. Our linear spectrum, Gaussian start, selected series and 4000-step Fig.3-style extension are project choices. Fig.3 kappa is back-calculated from e*sqrt(8*kappa)=700. Agreement is qualitative, not array parity.
